requirement: Help's stop shows once and stops Help while a /help answer streams, with or without the microphone or chat-input

oracle.ref: PR #1382 (fix); fix evidence: #1379: on the dev deployment the seat was empty while /help streamed; the microphone at priority -1 held the single slot
oracle.invariant: S1: the seat holds .tv-help-stop with the stop label and no microphone; the click calls Help's stopAll. S2: .tv-help-stop and no .tv-voice-mic. S3: one .tv-voice-seat row holding .tv-voice, then .tv-help-stop, and exactly one .tv-help-stop. S4: the microphone alone and no .tv-help-stop; then only an empty .tv-voice-seat row. S5: idle draws nothing; streaming draws exactly one .tv-help-stop and no microphone; the click calls stopAll.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
